AURANGABAD: Producers' freight books name both a Maharashtra and a Bihar Aurangabad; GAIL's Aurangabad is the Maharashtra industrial town.
BILASPUR: A real town in Chhattisgarh and a real district in Himachal Pradesh share the name. GAIL's Bilaspur is the Chhattisgarh town — this is the exact collision the state guard in locations.py exists to catch (R20).
BUNDHI: No place called Bundhi in any gazetteer; taken as Bundi (Rajasthan) — GAIL's own list groups it among Rajasthan towns.
CHANDIGARH: A union territory that some freight books file under Punjab; treated as its own entry (Chandigarh), matching how producers price it as a distinct destination.
DAMTAL: Small Himachal Pradesh place near the Punjab border; several small places share the name nearby.
DIBIYAPUR: Recorded elsewhere as "Debiapur" (Auraiya district, Uttar Pradesh); spelling only, not a state dispute.
JAGDISHPUR: The name exists in Uttar Pradesh (Amethi), Bihar (Bhojpur) and elsewhere; Uttar Pradesh assumed from context.
KALOL: Two towns named Kalol in Gujarat (Gandhinagar district and Panchmahal district); HPL's freight book lists both under different rates.
KUDAL: Near the Maharashtra/Goa border; some freight books label it Goa. GAIL's Kudal is the Maharashtra (Sindhudurg district) town.
LOTE: Not found under any spelling; likely Lote Parshuram (Ratnagiri district, Maharashtra) but unconfirmed. See open-questions.md.
RANIA: Rania exists in Haryana (Sirsa district) and in Uttar Pradesh (Kanpur Dehat district); Haryana assumed.
RATHANGARH: Taken as Ratangarh (Churu district, Rajasthan); spelling only.
SANSARPUR TERRACE: Small Kangra district (Himachal Pradesh) place; not separately listed in most gazetteers.
SILVASSA / DADRA & NAGAR HAVELI: The union territory's two former names/labels appear separately across producers' books; both refer to the same place.
TARAPUR: Producers' freight books disagree between a Maharashtra (Boisar) and a Gujarat Tarapur; GAIL's is the Maharashtra one (Boisar industrial area).
YANAM: A Puducherry exclave physically inside Andhra Pradesh; some freight books file it under Andhra Pradesh by geography rather than jurisdiction. Puducherry is the correct administrative state.
